countries.name: EU & cross-border
countries.headline: ACER, ENTSO-E, EC network-code implementation, coupling and REMIT-adjacent developments
countries.summary: Use this bucket for items that apply across Member States or describe EU-level market architecture. RSS ingestion defaults many headlines here until you tag them to a Member State in `seed-items.json`.
countries.developer_conditions: Track EU-level **RES support** (auctions, State aid/CfD conversations), **storage** eligibility in market/network codes, **grid / UoS** charging principles, **levies** on bills, and **gas / energy retail** measures that shift pass-throughs. Note **proposal vs adopted** texts.
countries.bess_framing: EU-level reforms (balancing, congestion tools, market coupling) change the boundary conditions for storage—but national implementation still dominates access rules.

countries.name: Germany
countries.headline: Coupled wholesale markets, evolving grid and flexibility needs
countries.summary: Track Bundesnetzagentur decisions, TSO consultation (Amprion, 50Hertz, TenneT DE, TransnetBW), and EU network code implementation.
countries.developer_conditions: Watch **EEG / RES support** and tariff rules, **BESS** consultations (co-located vs standalone), **grid permits / connection** timelines, **UoS and charges**, **taxes/levies** on bills, and any **gas / end-user tariff** measures that move pass-throughs. Separate **proposal vs adopted** BNetzA/BMWK texts.
countries.bess_framing: Watch balancing product definitions, marginal flexibility procurement, and congestion-management rules that affect storage utilisation.

countries.name: France
countries.headline: Nuclear-heavy system with growing flexibility and market reform threads
countries.summary: CRE deliberations, RTE publications, and EU-level market design changes implemented nationally.
countries.developer_conditions: Track **RES support** (capacity/ CfD-style mechanisms, auctions), **storage** rules under deliberations, **RTE connection / UoS** charges, **retail tariff** components, and **gas** price or tariff measures feeding into power bills—always note **draft vs final**.
countries.bess_framing: Note rules for participation in balancing and reserve markets versus energy arbitrage constraints.

countries.name: Spain
countries.headline: Renewable integration and reform of market/regulatory instruments
countries.summary: CNMC initiatives, REE operator materials, and Spanish implementation of EU electricity market rules.
countries.developer_conditions: Track **RES remuneration** routes, **BESS** consultations, **REE/TSO grid and UoS** rules, **consumer bill** charges, and **gas** policy affecting power costs. Distinguish **proposal vs BOE-published** measures when tagging.
countries.bess_framing: Assess AS markets, congestion, and any capacity or flexibility mechanisms—policy context only.

countries.name: Switzerland
countries.headline: Non-EU interconnectivity and domestic market rules
countries.summary: Swissgrid and ElCom publications; distinguish Swiss arrangements from EU market couplings.
countries.developer_conditions: Track **support schemes** for new renewables, **storage** eligibility, **Swissgrid charges / UoS**, **permitting and grid hosting**, and **gas / retail-bill** mechanics. Separate **consultation vs ElCom final**.
countries.bess_framing: Cross-border availability and Swiss balancing participation rules are key watchpoints.

countries.name: Poland
countries.headline: Capacity and balancing reforms alongside integration with EU market architecture
countries.summary: URE decisions, PSE materials, and implementation of network codes.
countries.developer_conditions: Watch **RES auctions / support**, **BESS** pathways, **PSE grid connection and UoS**, **levies** on final tariffs, and **gas / retail** measures shifting pass-throughs. Mark **draft vs URE adopted** clearly.
countries.bess_framing: Follow ancillary service product design and access conditions for distributed flex.

countries.name: Nordics (multi-area)
countries.headline: Nord Pool areas with zonal complexity (SE, NO, DK, FI)
countries.summary: Use explicit bidding zones when interpreting prices or constraints; follow Energinet, Fingrid, Statnett, Svenska kraftnät and Nord Pool notices.
countries.developer_conditions: Track **national RES support** (CfDs / premium routes vary), **storage** consultations, **TSO grid + UoS** charges per area, and **retail/gas** policies feeding bills. Tag the relevant **bidding-zone market** in signals when it matters.
countries.bess_framing: Local congestion and mFRR/balancing developments drive storage value; treat as policy signal not revenue forecast.

countries.name: United Kingdom
countries.headline: GB market separated from EU arrangements; own grid code and market reform path
countries.summary: Ofgem, National Grid ESO, and government consultations on market design and operability.
countries.developer_conditions: Follow **CfD / RES support** rounds, **storage** policy (licensing, planning), **DUoS / TNUoS and use-of-system**, **levies** on bills, and **gas / retail-price-cap** measures—tag **consultation vs final** determinations.
countries.bess_framing: Dynamic containment / regulation products and ancillary market reforms are central for storage participation routes.

countries.name: Italy
countries.headline: MVP: lighter default coverage unless expanded
countries.summary: Short default copy in the MVP—deepen ARERA / MASE / Terna sources in `seed-items.json` when you want more detail here.
countries.developer_conditions: Track **RES support** decisions, consultations on **BESS** (including routes discussed in policy circles under labels such as **TOPE**—verify the exact decree/law name in **Gazzetta Ufficiale** or the responsible ministry/ARERA acts), **ARERA tariff and UoS** components, **grid / permit** processes, and **bollette** measures that shift pass-throughs or incentives. **Gas** decree-law chapters can move power bill items; separate **proposal vs adopted** wherever possible.
countries.bess_framing: Balancing gatekeeping and dispatch rules materially affect participation paths—verify in ARERA/Terna primary sources before relying on shorthand labels.
